behavior.arguments: rdi = struct base; esi = index (32-bit, zero-extended, then times 8). [rdi+0x60] is the table base; [rdi+0x68] is the count field (32-bit load, low 6 bits used as the shift amount). No other argument is read and no field is written.

branch_targets.0x52cfe47: jb to 0x52cfe20 (loop head) while counter < count; falls through to return otherwise

edges.count_mask: field 0x3f gives count 1<<63; field 0x40 wraps to count 1 (low 6 bits).
edges.four_element: with table qwords 5, 7, 11 at strides 0, 0xce40, 2*0xce40 and index 0, count field 2 gives 5+7+11+0 = 23 (fourth slot reads 0 in the edge fixture).
edges.index_offset: with index 1 and count field 1, the sum reads the +8 slots: 3+4 = 7.
edges.single_element: count field 0 gives count 1: the loop executes exactly once (do-while shape).

behavior.entry_shape: Opens with endbr64; zero calls inside; one backward conditional branch (jb) forming the loop; a single ret.
behavior.return_rule: rax = sum of count = 1 << ([rdi+0x68] & 0x3f) qwords at [rdi+0x60] + i*0xce40 + (esi zero-extended)*8, i = 0..count-1, wrapping mod 2^64. The loop always executes at least once (counter is incremented before the first compare, and count >= 1).
behavior.stride_uniqueness: The 0xce40-stride add bytes (49 81 c0 40 ce 00 00) occur exactly once in all of .text, at 0x52cfe2b inside this window — this loop is not part of a stride-loop population.
behavior.twin_guard: Full claimed-body byte-compare top match is only 17/77 vs 0x4fec860, which disassembles as a linked-list / hash-bucket search with div — a completely different rule (shared bytes are common opcodes, not a shared body). NOT a twin.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; exactly three sites found, each boundary-confirmed inside its own caller FDE and independently resolved to the window start by objdump's caller disassembly. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: No R_X86_64_RELATIVE record in any .rela.* section names this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries).
